title: gjsify authored status data
description: Per-package AUTHORED status for STATUS.md generation (scripts/generate-status.mjs). Only what cannot be derived belongs here: the human status claim and its prose. Derivable facts (tier, runtimes, platforms, GNOME libs, test counts) are read from the package manifests at generation time — additionalProperties: false is what makes restating them impossible. The authoritative validator is loadStatusData() in scripts/generate-status.mjs (dependency-free, runs in CI via the status-data conformance rule); this schema file serves editor tooling.

packages.description: One entry per package under packages/ (every published package MUST have one; entries for private packages are allowed).

status.description: full = implemented for its declared scope · partial = core works, named gaps · stub = placeholder API surface · meta = dep-only umbrella, no runtime code · native = Vala/C/Rust GI prebuild bridge (must declare gjsify.prebuilds) · poc = proof-of-concept scope

note.description: What the package provides / how — the human-authored prose cell of the status table. Markdown inline formatting allowed; keep facts that a manifest already declares OUT of it.

missing.description: partial only (required there): what is missing and why — the gap IS the point of the partial status.
